LHX.sentence: L3Harris drifted down again and is sitting close to its lowest point of the year, but nothing has changed about steady military demand for its communications and electronic warfare gear — it's just the smallest of the big defense contractors and tends to trade at a discount.

ASML.sentence: ASML is sitting right at its highs and having a quiet day, which is normal for the only company on earth that makes the machines used to print the most advanced computer chips.

LIN.sentence: Linde is having a nothing week — industrial gas demand is steady, though for once it's trading in line with rivals rather than at its usual small premium.

MSFT.sentence: Microsoft is quiet — its stock has quietly outrun the other tech giants over the past month as the Azure cloud and AI story keeps grinding along without drama.

TMO.sentence: Thermo Fisher ticked up nicely, and there's a hopeful sign underneath: money is flowing back into biotech, which usually means more lab equipment orders for them a few quarters down the road.

ENB.sentence: Enbridge ticked up and is priced attractively for an income holding — it runs oil and gas pipelines like a toll road, collecting steady fees no matter the oil price.

GLNCY.sentence: Glencore jumped nicely and is outrunning other copper miners, a sign its huge commodity-trading arm is doing well on top of the mining.

MLM.sentence: Martin Marietta slipped a little, but the price it gets for a ton of crushed stone is still creeping up — the reported figures look weaker only because of the mix of products sold, not because the business is softening.

KOF.sentence: Coca-Cola FEMSA, the big Latin American Coke bottler, is flat and looks reasonably priced, with the Mexican peso sitting in a comfortable middle range rather than working against it.

PBR.A.sentence: Petrobras is up a bit on strong oil prices, but with oil this high its earnings may be near a peak, so the good times could be as good as they get for now.

AMKBY.sentence: Maersk, the Danish container-shipping giant, has run up sharply over the past couple of months and looks a little stretched in the short term, even though its ships and assets are still valued cheaply.

MA.sentence: Mastercard is flat and actually priced slightly below rival Visa, which is unusual given it's the faster grower — people keep tapping their cards millions of times a day, so the underlying toll-collecting business is fine.

ISRG.sentence: No fresh data on the surgical robot company today, so there's nothing new to report on Intuitive Surgical.
